hazards.summary: Alpine weather changes rapidly; strong winds, rain, and temperature drops common.
mitigations: Check weather forecasts before heading into alpine areas.
Carry layered clothing: waterproof shell, warm mid-layer, thermal base layer.
Carry headlamp, spare batteries, and emergency shelter.

hazards.summary: Volcanic and geothermal areas present burn risks from hot ground and steam.
mitigations: Stay on marked tracks and boardwalks in geothermal areas.
Keep safe distance from geysers and hot springs.
Supervise children and pets closely in thermal areas.

hazards.summary: Remote areas have limited fuel and supply access; long distances between services.
mitigations: Plan fuel stops before entering remote areas.
Carry extra food, water, and emergency supplies.
Check DOC hut bookings and track conditions in advance.

hazards.summary: Ferry services between North and South Islands can be disrupted by weather.
mitigations: Allow buffer time for ferry crossings; weather can delay or cancel services.
Have backup plans: alternative ferry times or ports.
Book flexible accommodation for ferry day.

then.message: Alpine weather changes rapidly in New Zealand. Pack layered clothing: waterproof/windproof shell, warm mid-layer (fleece/wool), thermal base layer. Also carry headlamp, spare batteries, and emergency shelter.
